story: A five-rider breakaway was caught with 40 km remaining, sparking a series of attacks from the peloton. A strong group of 12 riders eventually formed. Izagirre and Simmons attacked, later joined by Beloki, before Izagirre made a decisive move 1.5 km from the finish to take his third victory.
